scope: Independent CPU readback of retained evidence; no GPU kernels rerun. Timing arithmetic, fixture ownership/traffic/support, source provenance, and test logs verified independently.

timing_definition.primary: For each layer and variant, median of each rank's 10 per-replay CUDA durations, then maximum across 8 ranks. Layer totals sum these eight maxima. median(max rank per sample) is independently recomputed and retained separately.
timing_definition.unit: milliseconds; raw entries already divided by five replays

allowed_post_benchmark_difference.change: Replace unavailable cute.make_fragment((H_PER,), Float32) with cute.make_rmem_tensor((H_PER,), Float32), plus explanatory comment. Reversing only that edit reproduces the exact old SHA.
allowed_post_benchmark_difference.reason: Planner benchmark does not execute grad_reduce. Final gradient kernel is separately exercised by the successful eight-rank weights_attempt03; failed attempt02 remains preserved.

components.scope: Two physical GPUs with eight original logical source shards; correctness only, not eight-GPU runtime/performance evidence.

limitations: Actual physical address arrays, cumulative segments and sign-encoded dedup markers are not persisted in the JSON. Their uniqueness/segment/no-padding/sign checks are verified as runtime audit flags; this CPU readback does not claim to rerun them. Fixture owner SHA matching enables independent owner/load/traffic/support recomputation.

Runtime source sharding and unchanged-input checks are attested by benchmark code plus recorded audits. The independent CPU audit may load full fixtures; the measured planner retains source-local routes.
Five main tests per rank cover configuration, B8/B44 dynamic public forward/backward token paths, nondefault process group/global fallback, and graph replay. They are not complete model training.

Separate weight test covers actual BF16 peer weight refresh and FP32 replica parameter-gradient reduction over three projections and two disjoint mappings/versions, using S=257,H=256,B=44. Gradients are constructed test payloads, not GEMM-generated gradients; no optimizer or full model training is measured.

Planner-only timing excludes token/expert/gradient payloads and cannot establish positive training or end-to-end benefit. Eight-layer timing sums are per-layer measurements, not an end-to-end eight-layer latency recording.
Totals are sums of per-layer transfer counts for one replay per layer; do not multiply them by samples, repeats, ranks, or four training passes without stating that separate model.
